caption: The drawing is a monochrome pencil sketch on a pale background, featuring a triangular tray with three cylindrical containers arranged on top. The two containers on the left and right have lids; the left one has an embossed design on top, and the right one has a raised, smaller cylindrical section on its lid. The central container has a perforated lid, resembling a shaker, and behind it is a circular, upright handle with a ridged edge. Each corner of the triangular tray is adorned with a lion's head at the tip, with detailed facial features, and paws extending outward. In the bottom left corner of the drawing, there is a separate, ornate crest or shield illustration, showing a bird (possibly a swan or a goose) with its head curved, set within a decorated frame. The signature "V. Carano" is visible at the lower right of the drawing. The objects are rendered with careful shading to suggest metallic surfaces and three-dimensional form.
title: Silver Ink Stand
